LCAnomalyCore.Defs.AbnormalityCodexEntry.label: Der Freischütz
LCAnomalyCore.Defs.AbnormalityCodexEntry.description: Der Freischütz (F-01-69) is an eerie marksman bound to a magic bullet contract.\nSpend 10 IndiPE-Boxes to unleash a map-spanning piercing Black shot—remembering that the seventh bullet always betrays its contractor to strike a colonist.
